en: Black-and-white postcard showing a rural landscape with a church featuring a tall tower and bulbous spire on the right, and several school or residential buildings to the left, set behind trees and open fields in the foreground. At the top, printed text in Swedish reads "Färentuna kyrka och skola." There are a few handwritten annotations and marks near the top center and next to the church tower.
